svg.title: AI is the velocity; creativity is the vector.
svg.desc: AI is the runtime — the infinite lever of productivity. Creativity is the source — the origin of everything. Before the next token, creativity writes the first prompt. Live GitHub contribution spectrum across 31 weeks and 1,242 contributions.
svg.text: 「 AI 即生产力 · 创造力即一切 」

g.text: AI is the runtime & lever — turning intent into throughput.
▸ Predicts the next token · scales productivity to infinity.
Creativity is the source — the direction & meaning of everything.
✦ Writes the first prompt · defines what deserves to exist.

svg.text: Before the next token, creativity writes the first prompt.
